summary: Phase-2 admin Manual Job Posts CRUD tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 10 backend pytest cases pass. Full admin UI flow (create/edit/delete/confirm-modal), public-feed integration and Apply-Now block on VacancyDetail all work.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1484 lines — should be split into modules (auth, vacancies, admin, applications) for maintainability.
Manual vacancy PUT uses ManualVacancyIn which requires title>=3 chars; there is no partial-update option. Acceptable for this feature scope.
Public /api/vacancies filter for state='haryana' relies on state slug set by admin; no validation that supplied state is a known slug. Low priority.
seed_data_creation: Test vacancies (TEST_Manual QA Post, UI QA Manual TEST, PUBLIC FEED MANUAL TEST) were created and deleted during test run; DB is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Manual vacancy CRUD endpoints under /api/admin/vacancies use Bearer token from /api/auth/login access_token. Manual docs have source='manual' and url='internal://manual/{uuid}'. Guardrail on PUT/DELETE non-manual returns 400. Public feed and detail expose manual docs; VacancyDetail shows [data-testid=vacancy-manual-apply] block only when source==manual AND apply_url set. Scraper refresh preserves manual docs.
